name: ═══════════════ SMS GATEWAY INTERFACE (mirrors all Telegram) ═══════════════
info:
## SMS Gateway Command Interface

**Flow Number:** 514
**Domain:** SMS/Notifications (500-599)

### Purpose
Mirrors ALL Telegram commands via SMS. Parse incoming SMS as commands and reply via SMS.

### Commands (same as Telegram, via SMS)
SERVER: BOOT [dell|hp], SHUTDOWN [dell|hp], FORCE [dell|hp], STATUS
GATE: GATE_OPEN, GATE_STATUS
SLIDING: SLIDING_OPEN, SLIDING_CLOSE, SLIDING_TRIGGER, SLIDING_STATUS
SECONDARY: SECONDARY_OPEN, SECONDARY_CLOSE, SECONDARY_TRIGGER, SECONDARY_STOP, SECONDARY_LIGHT_LEFT, SECONDARY_LIGHT_RIGHT, SECONDARY_STATUS
GARDEN: GARDEN_ON, GARDEN_OFF, GARDEN_TOGGLE, GARDEN_STATUS
LIGHTS: LIGHTS_ON, LIGHTS_OFF, LIGHTS_STATUS
PUMP: PUMP_START, PUMP_STOP, PUMP_DRAIN, PUMP_TRENCH1_ON, PUMP_TRENCH1_OFF, PUMP_TRENCH2_ON, PUMP_TRENCH2_OFF, PUMP_STATUS
AQUARIUM: AQUARIUM_ON, AQUARIUM_OFF, AQUARIUM_TOGGLE, AQUARIUM_STATUS
SMS: SMS_STATUS, SMS_LOG
OTHER: HELP, COMMANDS

### Authorization
Set flow context 'sms_allowed_phones' to array of phone numbers to restrict access.
